subject: sourcing tags styles in global.R - a demo

messages.author: b949e0841d7e094b
messages.subject: sourcing tags styles in global.R - a demo
parts:
I had some apps with very long lists of customized styles that made it messy to read my ui.R and, in addition, I wanted several of my apps to share the same styles, so I figured a simple way would be to store the styles in global.R and to source it explicitly from ui.R. So this is how I made it to work. It's not extensively tested. There may be better ways, but I thought that keeping the styles in global.R was quite natural.

For what it's worth and without guarantees:

library("shiny")
runGist("https://gist.github.com/ptoche/8386571")

messages.author: a814dd0eade31e3e
messages.subject: Re: sourcing tags styles in global.R - a demo
parts:
You could put the styles in a css file and include the following in ui.R

includeCSS("www/style.css")
